scope: Independent hand-constructed public-protocol controls; no DUT/Claude source or target evidence used.

controls.name: positive/read
controls.obligation: Read response/payload conservation

controls.name: positive/write_mask
controls.obligation: Write payload and byte enables

controls.name: positive/slave_error
controls.obligation: Slave ERR propagation, not a successful read

controls.name: positive/unmapped
controls.obligation: Documented unmapped-address error without slave request

controls.name: positive/concurrent
controls.obligation: Two different destinations and response owners

controls.name: positive/pipeline
controls.obligation: Consecutive accepts, slave accept/response overlap, ACK while STB is low

controls.name: positive/accept_and_return
controls.obligation: Master acceptance and earlier response on the same edge

controls.name: positive/master1
controls.obligation: Upper public packed port slices

controls.name: positive/reset_then_new
controls.obligation: New transaction after completed work and synchronous reset

controls.name: positive/reset_inflight
controls.obligation: Reset cancels outstanding work; new epoch completes independently

controls.name: negative/read_data
controls.obligation: Wrong returned read data

controls.name: negative/write_data
controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded write payload

controls.name: negative/write_mask
controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded byte mask

controls.name: negative/address
controls.obligation: Wrong forwarded address

controls.name: negative/direction
controls.obligation: Read changed to write

controls.name: negative/missing_forward
controls.obligation: Fabricated master completion without forwarding or slave response

controls.name: negative/wrong_owner
controls.obligation: Response delivered to wrong master

controls.name: negative/duplicate_response
controls.obligation: No response without outstanding accepted work

controls.name: negative/error_as_success
controls.obligation: Slave error cannot become success

controls.name: negative/stale_after_reset
controls.obligation: Stale response in a reset-cleared epoch

controls.name: negative/stale_into_new_epoch
controls.obligation: Premature completion of new accepted work before forwarding/response, after reset

controls.name: negative/early_unexplained_error
controls.obligation: Mapped request fails one cycle after first activity without slave ERR or elapsed OPT_TIMEOUT=16; requires independent review of timeout applicability

controls.name: incomplete/missing_return
controls.obligation: No complete/scoped pass with unretired work; no invented liveness deadline

controls.name: incomplete/truncated
controls.obligation: Pending response at end must remain explicit

controls.name: invalid/master_changes_stalled_payload
controls.obligation: Changing stalled request is an external assumption violation

authority: Wishbone B4 pp31–38; public WBXBAR interface/README intent in spec-packet-v1. Chosen trace delays are test fixtures, not asserted implementation latency.
credit: Positive requires no functional/assumption errors and declared obligations checked; negative only credited with clean baseline and valid environment; incomplete must retain pending/unresolved, never success. Disputed controls require independent review, not forced checker changes.
